subheading: Papers are linked automatically by shared keywords.

passes.title: Pass 1 — get the gist
passes.body: Read the title, abstract, intro, section headings, and conclusion. Skim the references. Decide whether it's worth reading further.

passes.title: Pass 2 — read with care
passes.body: Read in order but skip proofs. Note key points, study the figures and diagrams, mark unread references worth following up.

passes.title: Pass 3 — re-implement it
passes.body: Virtually re-implement the paper. Challenge every assumption, note weaknesses, imagine how you'd present the idea yourself.

threePassInfo.intro: A quick way to read a paper without getting lost in the details on the first pass, from S. Keshav's "How to Read a Paper".

clear.title: Clear the board
clear.body: This removes every paper you've added. This can't be undone.

restore.title: Reset the board
restore.body: This replaces the board with the original papers and resets every status to to-read. This can’t be undone.
